name: ycombinator
description: Y Combinator public site (ycombinator.com): search the YC startup directory (via YC's Algolia index), look up companies, their jobs and job postings, Launch YC posts, the jobs board, and YC people.

commands.name: list-directory-categories
commands.summary: List the directory's industry and location categories with their URL slugs, plus links to hiring-by-location pages

params.name: industry
params.description: Industry name to get context for, e.g. 'Developer Tools'

params.name: location
params.description: Location slug to get context for, e.g. 'san-francisco-bay-area'

commands.name: get-company
commands.summary: Get a YC company's profile page by slug (title/tagline and summary description with founders, team size, location, hiring)

params.name: slug
params.description: Company slug as it appears in YC company URLs, e.g. airbnb

commands.name: list-company-jobs
commands.summary: List the open job postings of a YC company

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get a job posting (title, description, salary range, location, remote type, date posted) from its structured JobPosting data

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id plus slug as it appears in the job URL, e.g. HmK9Iqk-machine-learning-engineer

commands.name: get-launch
commands.summary: Get a Launch YC post: title, tagline, upvote count, author, company link and posting date

params.name: id
params.description: Launch id plus slug from the launch URL, e.g. ObJ-koyal-the-agentic-ai-filmmaking-platform

commands.name: list-jobs
commands.summary: List featured jobs at YC startups from the Work at a Startup jobs board

commands.name: list-jobs-by-role
commands.summary: List jobs at YC startups for one role (e.g. product-manager, software-engineer)

params.name: role
params.description: Role slug, e.g. product-manager, software-engineer, designer, sales, marketing

commands.name: list-jobs-by-role-location
commands.summary: List jobs at YC startups for one role in a given location or remote

params.name: location
params.description: 'remote' or a location slug such as san-francisco

commands.name: list-people
commands.summary: List YC people (president, partners, staff) with short bios and profile links

commands.name: get-person
commands.summary: Get a YC person's profile (name, role, bio) by slug

params.name: slug
params.description: Person slug from list-people URLs, e.g. jared-friedman

notes: search-companies and list-company-facets use YC's public, search-only Algolia key. The recording may have cut the key short (it decodes to an HMAC followed by 'analytic…'). If Algolia returns 403 'Invalid API key', copy the current key from window.AlgoliaOpts in the /companies page source.
search-companies sends search params as a JSON object in each Algolia multi-query request. The web app sent the same parameters as a URL-encoded 'params' string.

Industry and location listing pages (/companies/industry/{name}, /companies/location/{slug}) are rendered from the same Algolia index. Use search-companies with filters like industries:"Developer Tools" or regions:"America / Canada". Get valid values from list-company-facets.
Sort by launch date: set index=YCCompany_By_Launch_Date_production. This index name is the replica the YC site uses, but the recorded bodies did not show it.
Filtering only on 'Developer Tools' etc. requires exact facet values, case-sensitive and quoted when they contain spaces, e.g. batch:"Fall 2025" AND isHiring:true.

Launch YC search and listing (/launches?q=&sort=votes&batch=) are rendered client-side from Algolia, and their index was not recorded. Only get-launch (the server-rendered detail page) is available. Get launch ids from /launches URLs.
Company, person and job-board pages are mostly client-rendered, so the HTML extraction is limited to title/meta and link lists. get-job returns full structured data (schema.org JobPosting).
list-company-jobs and job-board lists match links containing '/jobs/'. Ignore any navigation links (e.g. /jobs/role/...) that are not /companies/{slug}/jobs/{id} URLs.

dropped.name: search-companies
dropped.summary: Search the YC Startup Directory by keyword, with optional filters (batch, industry, region, hiring, top company, nonprofit) and sort by relevance or launch date

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text keyword search over company names, one-liners and descriptions. Empty string matches all companies.

params.name: filters
params.description: Algolia filter expression on facets. Combine with AND/OR and quote values that contain spaces. Facets: batch (e.g. batch:"Fall 2025"), industries (e.g. industries:"Developer Tools"), subindustry, regi

params.name: index
params.description: Sort order. YCCompany_production sorts by relevance. YCCompany_By_Launch_Date_production sorts newest launched first.
